company.name: ICT Circle
company.shortDescription: ICT Circle is a global B2B ICT marketplace and networking platform that connects vendors, distributors, resellers, and system integrators.
company.description: ICT Circle is a Dubai-based B2B platform designed for the global ICT (Information and Communication Technology) ecosystem. The platform enables vendors, distributors, resellers, and system integrators to connect, engage, trade, and manage business operations through a unified digital marketplace. It offers a wide range of services including product sourcing, partner networking, lead generation, logistics support, secure payments, escrow services, inventory management, analytics dashboards, and digital marketing tools. ICT Circle aims to modernize the ICT supply chain by providing businesses with a secure and collaborative environment where they can expand globally, discover verified partners, and optimize operational efficiency. The platform also supports AI-powered business insights, shipment verification, insurance assistance, SEO/SMO marketing, and real-time communication tools to help companies improve profitability and customer reach. With its focus on digital transformation and channel ecosystem growth, ICT Circle serves as a comprehensive business enablement platform for IT and technology companies worldwide.
